campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.heading: Campaigns
campaigns.none: No campaign opened or running. Check the calibration below, import the history if the window is short, then open the campaign: it starts the following Monday.

live.startsOn: Starts on {{date}}. The roster and the reference are already frozen; if something is wrong, delete the campaign and open it again.

calibration.label: Calibration
calibration.heading: What a campaign opened today would be given

uncovered.one: {{count}} operator is not covered by their history: the window was shrunk for everyone. Import the history before opening.
uncovered.other: {{count}} operators are not covered by their history: the window was shrunk for everyone. Import the history before opening.

backfill.heading: Import the history
backfill.description: Walks nine months of matches back for every active operator, in the background, so the calibration is measured on the whole window. Thousands of calls under the Riot rate limit: follow it in the synchronization history.
backfill.accepted: Import started. Follow its progress in the operations.

open.heading: Open the campaign
open.description: Freezes the active roster, computes the reference and draws the ten guardians. The campaign starts the following Monday and runs ten weeks. Refused while a campaign is opened or running.
open.confirmBody: The roster and the reference are frozen at this instant and never recomputed. Check the calibration first: it decides the size of the ten guardians.

stop.heading: Stop the campaign
stop.description: Closes the running campaign now, frozen at the last day that is over. Its score is never recomputed.
stop.confirmBody: The campaign closes today, with yesterday's base as its final score. The remaining weeks are never played. This cannot be undone.

delete.heading: Delete the campaign
delete.confirmBodyOpened: Campaign {{number}} has not started: deleting it removes its frozen roster and its ten guardians, nothing else. You can open a new one right away.
delete.confirmBody: Campaign {{number}} will be erased with its weeks, its days and its roster. Matches, challenges and rankings are kept. This cannot be undone.

login.heading: Command post
login.keyHint: The key opens synchronisation, roster management and campaign controls.
login.title: Administration

groups.repairHint: These replay history that is already written. Run them when a figure is wrong, not as part of an ordinary week.
groups.routineHint: The ordinary gestures of a week, with no retroactive effect.

recalculate.heading: Recalculate progress
recalculate.description: Rebuilds this week's challenge progress and the ranking from the matches already stored. Never calls the Riot API.

redraw.heading: Redraw the challenges
redraw.description: Throws away the current week's five challenges, draws five new ones from the catalogue as it now stands, then rebuilds progress and ranking. Use it when the draw itself became wrong: a challenge disabled or removed from the catalogue after the week opened.
redraw.confirmBody: The progress recorded against the discarded challenges is deleted with them: an operator who had completed one loses that completion, its points and the wounded it promised. Only the week in progress is touched. Replay the campaign afterwards.

rollover.heading: Run the rollover
rollover.description: Replays Monday's whole rollover: finalizes every past week left open, settles the campaign's Sundays, draws the week's challenges. It does not synchronize: run a synchronization first if the last matches are still missing.

syncAll.heading: Synchronize the squad
syncAll.description: Imports the recent matches of every tracked operator, then rebuilds progress, ranking and campaign. Several minutes, depending on the Riot rate limit.
syncAll.accepted: Synchronization started. Follow its progress in the panel above.

syncPlayer.heading: Synchronize one operator
syncPlayer.description: Catches up a single operator without replaying the others. Useful after an isolated failure during a scheduled run.

weekSelection.heading: Open the week
weekSelection.description: Draws the current week's five missing challenges and the daily one, exactly as Monday's rollover does. Does nothing when the week is already set up.
weekSelection.done: The current week is fully set up.

campaignReplay.heading: Replay the campaign
campaignReplay.description: Replays the running campaign from its first day, from the matches and challenges already stored. Safe: the base is never advanced incrementally, it is always recomputed in full.

dailySelection.heading: Draw the daily challenge
dailySelection.description: Draws today's challenge if the midnight tick missed it, from the pool of 21 with no repeat over 21 days. Does nothing when it is already drawn.

mission.title: The mission
mission.description: A squad holds a {base} *base*, and a {rocket} *ship* is being built in its middle. For ten weeks it goes after the {wounded} *wounded* left behind on ten planets: each week, one planet, one group to evacuate, and a {guardian} *guardian* pinning them to the ground until the squad breaks through its lines.
mission.score: Everything the operators play in Valorant feeds the base. The campaign's score is the *size of the base* {base}. The number of guardians defeated decides the final state of the rocket {rocket}.

sync.name: Synchronization
sync.effect: Matches come in, the stocks {food} {components} rise, the guardian {guardian} takes the hits.

daily.name: Day
daily.effect: The base eats, the day closes, the day's challenge {challenge} is resolved.

weekly.name: Week
weekly.effect: The guardian goes down and the wounded {wounded} are rescued.

campaign.name: Campaign
campaign.effect: The rocket {rocket} is built, the final score is frozen.

resources.title: The two resources
resources.description: Every match produces {food} *food* and {components} *components* at once, split by the mode played: 30 % food in Competitive, Premier and Unrated, 70 % in Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Spike Rush and Skirmish. The amount split is the match's value.
resources.hourly: The values are set so that *an hour of play pays about the same whatever the mode*, diminishing returns included: between 680 and 780 {damage} per hour over a one-hour session. Swiftplay and Escalation are worth nothing.
resources.foodUse: Feed the base {base} every day, and settle Sunday's rescued {wounded}.
resources.componentsUse: Reach the survivors {wounded}: vehicles and expedition gear.
resources.stocks: *These are real stocks.* Nothing is reset: what was not spent stays in reserve from one week to the next, which is what lets a squad save up before a big week. Per match, competitive pays more of both; the trade-off exists per hour of play.

multipliers.title: The two multipliers
multipliers.description: They apply to every match and are shown on every operator's row: *diminishing returns* against farming, and the *streak of consecutive days* {streak} rewarding daily effort.
multipliers.decayLabel: Diminishing returns, by the match's rank in the day
multipliers.decayNote: The rank is computed by *decreasing value*, not by time: the day's best matches always keep 100 %, and a Deathmatch warm-up never devalues the competitive played after it. Until the day is over, a displayed total may slip back a little; it is settled at midnight.
multipliers.streakNote: The first day gives nothing: a bonus everyone has is not a bonus. The cap is deliberately low, so that an operator who skips a day can still catch the leader.

streakRules.individual: The streak {streak} is *individual* and reset at midnight as soon as an operator skips a day.
streakRules.valued: A day counts if the operator played *at least one valued match* in it: a mode worth zero makes no day.
streakRules.wholeDay: As soon as one valued match exists, *every match of that day* takes the new counter's bonus. There is one bonus per day.
streakRules.calendar: A day {day} is the calendar day of the project's time zone, the one the match started in.
streakRules.neverStops: The counter never stops: not on Monday, not between two campaigns. The display keeps counting past six, “12 d”, but the bonus stays at +10 %.
streakRules.everything: The bonus applies to everything a match produces: damage {damage}, components {components}, food {food}, base growth {base}. *Never to challenges* {challenge}.

multipliers.combined: The two multiply: match value × diminishing return × (1 + streak bonus), rounded to the integer *once*, at the end, per match.

day.title: The day
day.description: A day {day} produces continuously and closes at midnight, in a fixed order. Everything played grows the base {base}, whatever the mode: no mode is a bad choice for the score.

grow.title: The base grows
grow.text: 28 damage {damage} make one inhabitant {base}. The only source of daily growth, deliberately neutral by mode.

guardian.title: The guardian takes the hits
guardian.text: Every match deals its damage {damage} to the guardian {guardian} as soon as it comes in, without waiting for the end of the day.

eat.title: The base eats
eat.text: Every inhabitant eats 0.008 food {food}. As long as the stock keeps up, all is well. Once it runs dry, the unfed inhabitants start dying.

daily.title: The day's challenge is resolved
daily.text: The wounded {wounded} it brings back are *earned whatever happens* and counted for Sunday: they leave with the ship.

day.upkeepLabel: Share of your food absorbed by upkeep, by week
day.upkeepNote: Upkeep rises with the population, gently and on purpose: a base of ten thousand needs more attention than a camp of one thousand, without ever becoming the main subject.
day.famineLabel: Inhabitants lost, by evenings of famine
day.famineNote: In ordinary play the base never starves: the ship always leaves seven meals aside on Sunday. Famine only begins *once the reserve is empty*, so after more than a week without a single match; every evening without food, 5 % of the unfed inhabitants die. The real price of stopping is the guardian {guardian} left standing: 35 % of the base.

week.title: The week
week.description: The guardian {guardian} has hit points set on Monday. *Every match played by any active operator deals it damage* {damage}, within thirty minutes. It can fall on Tuesday at noon as well as on Sunday night. Only matches hurt it: a completed challenge {challenge} deals none, it brings back wounded.
week.live: The fight is strictly insensitive to the mix of modes: the total played is what counts. When it falls, the application records *who dealt the finishing blow and on which match*. The week is not over for that: the remaining days keep filling the reserves and growing the base. Killing the guardian early is an advantage, never an end of week.

challenges.value: what the week's challenges {challenge} brought back, never more than the group

extraction.value: the smallest of: the rest of the group, what the components {components} can reach, what the food {food} can settle; multiplied by the *breach* on the guardian

week.settlementNote: The challenge wounded are part of the spotted group: they leave first, without spending resources and without the breach applying. The breach is 1 if the guardian fell, otherwise the share of its hit points removed. Components and food are only spent on the wounded *actually extracted*: 14 {components} and 12 {food} per wounded aboard.
week.protectedFood: *The ship never touches the next seven meals.* Before extracting, the food of the seven evenings to come is set aside; only the food beyond that reserve pays for beds.
week.lossLabel: If the guardian survives: base losses, by breach reached
week.lossNote: Losses are continuous and quadratic, with no threshold: base × (1 − breach)² × 35 %. Missing by a little costs almost nothing. Doing nothing costs a lot.
week.sundayOrder: *Sunday night's order*: the day's challenge is resolved, the guardian attacks if it still stands, then the ship returns and the rescued join the base. The wounded brought back never suffer the attack: they were not there yet.
week.monday: *Monday*: new group, new guardian. The reserves {food} {components} are kept; a bad week never costs the next one. The roster does not change during a campaign.
week.whoCounts: Only the operators *active on the opening Monday* count: for damage, resources, growth and challenge wounded. An inactive operator stays synchronized and sees their progress on every challenge, for reference: they measure how fast they would go, bringing nothing and costing nothing.

campaign.title: The campaign
campaign.description: Ten weeks, each with its own shape, described by two numbers expressed as a share of the squad's *reference*: the guardian's {guardian} weight and the size of the group of wounded {wounded}.
campaign.weightsNote: This produces weeks that play differently without a single rule changing.

six.title: Week 6
six.text: Big group, weak guardian. A supply run.

seven.title: Week 7
seven.text: Small group, tough guardian. A siege.

ten.title: Week 10
ten.text: The campaign's biggest group behind its biggest guardian.

campaign.progression: *Rewards climb*: groups and challenge rescues progress by +4 % per week, linearly, × 1.00 in week 1, × 1.36 in week 10. Never compounded. Combined with rising upkeep, the campaign gets progressively harder while paying better.

lifecycle.open: The administrator *opens* the campaign from the backoffice. At that instant the roster is frozen and the calibration is computed.
lifecycle.start: The campaign *starts the following Monday* and lasts ten weeks.
lifecycle.close: It *closes* after the tenth Sunday's settlement, and its final score is frozen.
lifecycle.between: Between two campaigns, no guardian, no base, no reserves: only the weekly ranking {points} keeps running. Every campaign starts from scratch.

calibration.title: Calibration and tiers
calibration.description: Before launch, the application reads the frozen roster's history and draws a *reference* from it: the weekly damage {damage} an operator of the squad produces on average. It sets the size of the guardians, of the groups, and the worth of the challenges.

facts.window: A window of *nine months* of history, for every active operator.
facts.average: The reference is the *mean of the weekly means*: the guardian is worth “reference × operators”, a sum being aimed at, and a very strong operator must weigh in it.
facts.emptyWeeks: Every week of the window counts, *including the ones without a single match*, at zero. An operator who plays little is a weak operator, and the reference must reflect it.
facts.floor: A *floor of 2,000*, four competitives and three quick matches a week. Below it, a guardian would fall in one evening.
facts.shrink: If an operator's history does not cover nine months, the window is *shrunk one month at a time, for everyone*, until each is covered.
facts.beginner: An operator with under a month of history is a *beginner*: they do not shrink the window and take the squad's median.
facts.once: The reference is computed *once*, at opening, and never recomputed.

calibration.sameMultipliers: *Critical point*: the reference is computed with exactly the same multipliers as during the campaign, streak {streak} and diminishing returns included. Applying them on one side and not the other would shift the guardian's bar by about 30 %.
calibration.tiersNote: The tier exists so that two squads of very different levels can compare their campaigns. *Every quantity is expressed per active operator*, which makes the game identical with 2 or 20 operators.

challenges.title: The challenges
challenges.description: *One daily challenge* {challenge}, shared by the squad, drawn every morning from a pool of 21 with no repeat over 21 days, resolved the same evening. *Five weekly challenges*, one per difficulty, drawn on Monday from a catalogue of 100. Both bring back wounded {wounded} earned whatever happens; neither deals damage to the guardian.
challenges.worthNote: Wounded and points per completing operator, at a reference of {{reference}}. A perfect week, seven daily challenges and the five weekly ones, is worth 120 wounded per operator. The values progress by +4 % per week, like everything else.

survivorsFormula.title: Wounded brought back
survivorsFormula.text: Per completing operator, paid on Sunday {wounded}. Proportional to the reference: the same relative weight for amateurs and for pros.

pointsFormula.title: Ranking points
pointsFormula.text: The week's ranking {points} adds the guardian damage {damage}, multipliers included, and the points of the completed challenges.

challenges.ranking: A perfect week of challenges is worth about 1,200 points, against 5,300 of damage for a median week: challenges weigh *a fifth of the ranking*, never half. The ranking shows, for every operator, the progress on every challenge in play.

titles.title: The titles
titles.description: Four titles handed out every week, so that recognition does not gather on a single operator. Purely honorary: an operator may hold several, and on a tie the title is not awarded.

rocket.title: The rocket
rocket.description: In the middle of the base, the rocket {rocket} is the campaign's trophy.
rocket.text: *Ten visual states indexed on the number of guardians defeated* {guardian}. Ten out of ten gives the full picture. No effect on the rules.

constants.title: The constants
constants.description: Every value of the game, in one table. Checked by simulation: a squad calibrated on itself beats 8 guardians out of 10, effort pays, and the result per operator is identical from 2 to 20 operators.

upkeep.label: Food eaten per inhabitant per day

famine.label: Daily loss under famine
famine.value: 5 % of the unfed share, only when the reserve is empty

groupSize.label: Group size
groupSize.value: reference × week weight × 0.050 × active operators × progression

componentsPerRescue.label: Components to reach 1 wounded
componentsPerRescue.value: 14, spent only on the wounded extracted

foodPerRescue.label: Food to settle 1 wounded
foodPerRescue.value: 12, spent only on the wounded extracted

challengeWounded.label: Challenge wounded

challengeSurvivors.label: Wounded brought back by a challenge
challengeSurvivors.value: reference × weight / 1000, per completing operator, paid on Sunday

calibrationWindow.label: Calibration window
calibrationWindow.value: 9 months, shrunk one month at a time while an operator is not covered

reference.label: Reference
reference.value: mean of the weekly means per active operator, empty weeks at zero, floor 2,000

readings.none: No campaign in progress: the base, the guardian and the reserves will show here from the next starting Monday.
readings.noDaily: Today's challenge is not drawn yet.
readings.noRanking: The week's ranking has not been computed yet.

intro.title: Your matches save lives
intro.claim: Every match is read automatically and feeds a *rescue mission* the whole squad shares.

base.title: The base is the score
base.claim: Everything played grows it, whatever the mode. *Its size at the end of the campaign* is the score.

week.title: One planet, one guardian, seven days
week.claim: Every match by any operator hits the guardian. *Break through its lines* and the ship brings the wounded home on Sunday.

spec1.label: from the match to the bar

spec2.label: of the base if it survives

resources.title: Food and components
resources.claim: Every match produces both at once, by mode. *These are real stocks*: nothing is reset on Monday.

challenges.title: One a day, five a week
challenges.claim: They bring back wounded *earned whatever happens*, spending no resource, and weigh a fifth of the ranking.

ranking.title: Who carried the week
ranking.claim: Guardian damage plus challenge points, reset on Monday. *Four titles* salute the rest, and the rules tell everything.
